getCalculatedChecks
customMethods.script:
'''
		This function will recursively find any check that has a direct or indirect reference to the check that has just had a value change. We do this because calculated checks can contain nested checks
	'''

	system.perspective.print("getCalculatedChecks() called with %s %s %s %s"%(chkName, calcChkList, group, calcItems))

	chkItems = self.view.custom.chkSht.chkItems
	for chkItemId in calcItems or []:
		calcChk = dict(chkItems[str(chkItemId)])
		if group is not None and calcChk['chkItemGroupName'] != group: continue	#This calcuated item is not on this tab group
		if calcChk['calculation'] is None: continue
		calculation = system.util.jsonDecode(calcChk['calculation'])
		calc = calculation['formulaType'] if calculation is not None else None
		formula = calculation['values'] if calculation is not None else None
		if formula is None: continue
#		system.perspective.print("%s %s formula is %s"%(calcChk['chkItemName'], calcChk['chkItemGroupName'], formula))
		chkName = "%s\%s"%(group, chkName)
		if "'" + chkName + "'" in formula: 
			calcChkList.append(calcChk['chkItemId'])
			#now we have to look to see if this calculator is used in any other calculators
			calcChkList = self.getCalculatedChecks(calcChk['chkItemName'], calcChkList, group, calcItems)

	return calcChkList

customMethods.name: updateCheckCalculations
customMethods.script:
'''
		This function will search for any calculated check items that are linked with the passed chkItem
		If we are passing in a checkItemName, then we will scan just the calculated check items in the current group
		If we don't pass in a chkItemName, then we will scan all calculated chkItems
		We only update calculated checks if they are on the open tab	to speed up the user entry process, so there may be some checks that haven't been calculated or updated.
		When we submit, we will update all checks.
	'''

	system.perspective.print("updateCheckCalculations() called for %s %s %s"%(chkItemId, measNum, chkItemGroupName))
	
	chkItems = self.view.custom.chkSht.chkItems
	chkItem = chkItems[str(chkItemId)]
	calcItems = [chkItemId for chkItemId in chkItems if chkItems[str(chkItemId)]['chkItemTypeName'] == 'Calculated' and (chkItemGroupName is None or chkItems[str(chkItemId)]['chkItemGroupName'] == chkItemGroupName)]
	measNum = measNum or 1

	calcChkItems = self.getCalculatedChecks(chkItem['chkItemName'], [], chkItem['chkItemGroupName'], calcItems)		#This will give us a list of chkItemIds for all calculated checks that need to be updated.
	system.perspective.print("getCalculatedChecks() returned %s"%calcChkItems)
	for calcChkItemId in calcChkItems:
		calcChkItem = chkItems[str(calcChkItemId)]
		calcItemInfo = {
						'chkShtEventId': self.view.custom.chkSht.info.chkShtEventId,
						'chkItemEventId': calcChkItem['measurements'][measNum - 1]['chkItemEventId'],
						'chkItemId': calcChkItem['chkItemId'],
						'chkItemValue': self.updateCheckCalculation(calcChkItem),
						'chkItemStateId': calcChkItem['measurements'][0]['chkItemStateId'],
						'measNumber': measNum or 1
					}

#		system.perspective.print("saveChkItemEvent() called with %s"%(calcItemInfo))
		if calcItemInfo['chkItemValue'] is None: 
			self.deleteChkItems(calcItemInfo)
		else:
			system.perspective.print("saveChkItemEvent() called with %s"%(calcItemInfo))
			if not system.kanoa.quality.event.saveChkItemEvent(calcItemInfo, self.view.custom.security.userId): 
				system.perspective.print("saveChkItemEvent() Failed")
				system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': "Failed to save the last check value %s)"%calcItemInfo})
			else: 
				system.perspective.print("saveChkItemEvent() Passed")
				system.perspective.sendMessage('showInfoToast', {'message': "%s value has been updated"%chkItem['chkItemName']})
	
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.chkSht.chkItems")

	return

customMethods.name: updateTriggerChkItems
customMethods.script:
#This function will be called whenever we get the trigger input to do so. This maybe from a codetime check item being populated or a boolean 'getValues'

	def setMessage(note, level):
		if level == 'showWarningToast': icon = u'❗'
		elif level == 'showFailerToast': icon = u'✘'
		elif level == 'showSuccessToast': icon = u'✔'
		else: icon = ''
	
		notes.append({'icon':icon, 'text': note})
		system.perspective.sendMessage(level, {'message': note})
#		system.perspective.print("note is %s"%note)
		return

	if triggerChkItemValue is None: return	#Should probably clear all the triggers perhaps?

	system.perspective.print("updateTriggerChkItems() called")	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showInfoToast', {'message': 'Checking trigger checks'})
	chkShtName = self.view.custom.chkSht.info.chkShtName
	chkShtEventId = self.view.custom.chkSht.info.chkShtEventId
	
	triggerType = triggerChkItem['dataTypeName']	#Used to determine if this is a historical lookup (DateTime) or an instantaneous reading (Boolean)
	chkItemTriggerDate = system.date.parse(triggerChkItemValue, "yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm") if triggerType == 'Datetime' else None
	notes = []
	
	chkItems = self.view.custom.chkSht.chkItems	
	triggeredChkItems = [chkItemId for chkItemId in chkItems if chkItems[str(chkItemId)]['chkItemTriggerId'] == triggerChkItem['chkItemId']]
	for chkItemId in triggeredChkItems:
		chkItem = dict(chkItems[str(chkItemId)])
		chkItemName = chkItem['chkItemName']
		tagPath = chkItem['sourceTagPath'] or None

		if tagPath is None:
			setMessage("Triggered check item %s doesn't have a tagPath associated to it. Ignoring..."%(chkItemName), 'showWarningToast')
			continue

#		system.perspective.print("Found triggered check item %s %s with %s. Trigger Type is %s"%(chkItemId, chkItemName, tagPath, triggerType))
#		system.perspective.print("measurements are %s"%chkItem['measurements'])
		for meas in range(1, chkItem['measCount'] +1):
#			system.perspective.print("Looking at measurement %s"%meas)
			
			if triggerType == 'Datetime': #This is historical

#				#This next line is custom for GP Gypsum codetime implementation
#				endDate, msg = kanoaScripts.custom.quality.calculators.getHistoricalTimeStamp(system.date.parse(triggerChkItemValue, "YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm"), tagPath)
#				setMessage('%s %s'%(endDate, msg), 'showInfoToast')
				endDate = system.date.parse(triggerChkItemValue, "YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm")
				startDate = system.date.addMinutes(endDate, -5)	#get the entered code time value
				tagData = system.tag.queryTagCalculations([tagPath], calculations=['Average'], startDate=startDate, endDate=endDate, noInterpolation=False)
				value = tagData.getValueAt(0, 1) if tagData.rowCount > 0 else None
				setMessage('Grabbed historical value of %s for %s from %s at %s'%(value, chkItemName, tagPath, triggerChkItemValue), 'showInfoToast')
			else: 
				value = system.tag.read(tagPath).value #Presume this is boolean. Grab the value now
				if value is not None: setMessage('Grabbed current value of %s for %s from %s'%(value, chkItemName, tagPath), 'showSuccessToast')
				else: setMessage('No value found for %s from %s'%(chkItemName, tagPath), 'showWarningToast')

			if value == 0 and chkItem['ignoreZeroValues']: value = None
			if value is not None: value = value * (chkItem['scaleFactor'] or 1)
			chkItemStateId, msg = self.getChkItemStateId(dict(chkItem), value)
			chkItemEventInfo = {'chkShtEventId':self.view.custom.chkSht.info.chkShtEventId,	'chkItemEventId': chkItem['measurements'][meas-1]['chkItemEventId'],	'chkItemId': chkItem['chkItemId'], 'measNumber': measNum or 1, 'chkItemValue': value, 'chkItemStateId': chkItemStateId}
			system.perspective.print("saveChkItemEvent() called with %s"%(chkItemEventInfo))
			if not system.kanoa.quality.event.saveChkItemEvent(chkItemEventInfo, self.view.custom.security.userId): system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': "Failed to save the last check value %s)"%chkItemEventInfo})
			else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showInfoToast', {'message': "%s value has been updated"%chkItem['chkItemName']})
	
	payload = {'values':{"infoList": notes, "popuId": "tagValueUpdate", "popupType": "textarea", "size": {"height": 200, "width": 290}, "timeout": False}}	
	if len(notes) > 0: system.perspective.openPopup('tagValueUpdate', 'kanoa/core/templates/displays/infoPopup', payload, title="Trigger Checks Info", resizable=True, position={'bottom' : 100}, viewportBound=True)

	return

customMethods.name: getTolerances
customMethods.script:
spec = system.util.jsonDecode(chkItemInfo['specification'])
	specs = {'lel':None, 'lsl':None, 'lcl':None, 'tgt':None, 'ucl':None, 'usl':None, 'uel':None}

	if spec:
		if spec['specType'] == 'attributeTolerance': #We got our specs from the attributes table
			specs['lel'] = chkItemInfo['lel']
			specs['lsl'] = chkItemInfo['lsl'] or chkItemInfo['ldl']
			specs['lcl'] = chkItemInfo['lcl']
			specs['tgt'] = chkItemInfo['tgt']
			specs['ucl'] = chkItemInfo['ucl']
			specs['usl'] = chkItemInfo['usl'] or chkItemInfo['udl']
			specs['uel'] = chkItemInfo['uel']
		elif spec['specType'] == 'tolerance':
			tolerances = spec['tolerance']
			specs['lel'] = tolerances['lel']
			specs['lsl'] = tolerances['lsl'] or tolerances['ldl']
			specs['lcl'] = tolerances['lcl']
			specs['tgt'] = tolerances['tgt']
			specs['ucl'] = tolerances['ucl']
			specs['usl'] = tolerances['usl'] or tolerances['udl']
			specs['uel'] = tolerances['uel']
		elif spec['specType'] == 'range':
			specs['lel'] = None
			specs['lsl'] = spec['range']['min']
			specs['usl'] = spec['range']['max']
	
	return specs

customMethods.script:
def findNextChkItem(chkItemId, direction):
		idx = orderedItems.index(chkItemId)
		
		if direction == 'RIGHT': idx += 1
		else: idx -= 1
		
		if idx < 0: idx = len(orderedItems) - 1
		elif idx == len(orderedItems): idx = 0
		
		return orderedItems[idx]

#	system.perspective.print("getNextChkItem() called with %s"%direction)
	
	chkItems = self.view.custom.chkSht.chkItems
	measNum = measNum or 1
	orderedItems = self.view.custom.chkSht.chkItemOrderedList
	
#	system.perspective.print("NAV - Start chkItemId = %s measNum = %s, "%(chkItemId, measNum))

	if direction == 'RIGHT':
		if measNum < chkItems[str(chkItemId)]['measCount']: 
			measNum += 1
		else: 
			measNum = 1
			chkItemId = findNextChkItem(chkItemId, direction)
	else:
		if measNum > 1:
			measNum -= 1
		else: 
			chkItemId = findNextChkItem(chkItemId, direction)
			measNum = chkItems[str(chkItemId)]['measCount']

#	system.perspective.print("NAV End chkItemId = %s measNum = %s"%(chkItemId, measNum))
		
	return chkItemId, measNum

	def selectNextCheck(chkItemId, measNum):
		#If the user has filtered the checks down by group and is going one by one, we  will increment to the next check, but if they want to see all
		#checks on a view, then we will leave it alone.
		import time
		time.sleep(1)
		
		chkItem = None
		i = 1
		while chkItem is None or chkItem['chkItemTypeName'] == 'Calculated' or chkItem['chkItemTriggerId'] is not None:
			chkItemId, nextMeasNum = self.getNextChkItem(chkItemId, measNum, 'RIGHT')
			chkItem = self.view.custom.chkSht.chkItems[str(chkItemId)]
			i += 1
			if i > 20: break
			
		system.perspective.print('sending setFocus() msg with %s'%{'chkItemId': chkItemId, 'measNumber': nextMeasNum})
		system.perspective.sendMessage('setFocus', {'chkItemId': chkItemId, 'measNumber': nextMeasNum})
	
		return
	
	system.perspective.print("Received ValuePicked message with %s"%payload)
	
	msg = 'msg not configured'
	
	self.view.custom.userInput.inputValue = '' #Clear keyboard value
	measNum = payload['measNum'] if payload.has_key('measNum') else self.view.custom.userSelection['measNum'] or 1
	chkItemId = payload['chkItemId']  if payload.has_key('chkItemId') else self.view.custom.userSelection['chkItemId']
	chkItem = self.view.custom.chkSht.chkItems[str(chkItemId)]

#	system.perspective.print("chkItem %s"%chkItem)
	
	if not self.view.custom.displaySettings.editMode: return #endFunction("Check Sheet is not in the right status to be updated. Exiting....")
	if self.view.custom.displaySettings.lockEditing: return	#system.perspective.print("Locked FOR EDITING. Exiting....")
	if self.view.custom.chkSht.info.chkShtStateName == 'Approved': return
	if chkItem['chkItemTypeName'] == 'Calculated': return	#Can't be added manually, we check at the end for updates to calculators	
		
	value = payload['value']
	self.view.custom.displaySettings.lockEditing = True

	if chkItem['chkItemTypeName'] == 'Trigger': #only do a trigger update if only one row has been selected
		self.updateTriggerChkItems(chkItem, measNum, value)
		self.updateCheckCalculations(chkItemId, measNum, None)
		endFunction('Trigger Checks Completed')
		selectNextCheck(chkItem['chkItemId'], measNum)
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.chkSht.chkItems")
		return

	#Let's do some data validation on the required type and value being entered
	if value is None:	#user is clearing the value
#		system.perspective.print("value is None")
#		system.perspective.print("chkItemId %s measNum %s dataTypeName %s"%(chkItemId, measNum, self.view.custom.chkSht.chkItems[str(chkItemId)].dataTypeName))
		if self.view.custom.chkSht.chkItems[str(chkItemId)].dataTypeName == 'Image':
			#We need to delete the image
			imageId = self.view.custom.chkSht.chkItems[str(chkItemId)].measurements[(measNum or 1)-1].chkItemValue
			system.kanoa.quality.image.deleteImage(imageId)
		
		chkShtItemEventInfo = {'chkShtEventId': self.view.custom.chkSht.info.chkShtEventId, 'chkItemId': chkItemId}
		if measNum: chkShtItemEventInfo['measNumber'] = measNum
		self.deleteChkItems	(chkShtItemEventInfo)
		import time
		time.sleep(0.1)
				
		self.updateCheckCalculations(chkItemId, measNum, None)
	elif chkItem['pickListName'] == 'Time':	#special case here, value is returned in format of 'hhmmss'. we'll convert it to seconds
		system.perspective.print("value is Time")
		val = str(value).zfill(6)
		value = int(val[:2]) * 3600 + int(val[2:4]) * 60 + int(val[4:6])
	elif chkItem['pickListName'] == 'Barcode Scanner' and chkItem['pickListValues'] is not None:
		args = {}
		measurements = {}
		system.perspective.print("Barcode scanner has script")
		pickListValues = system.util.jsonDecode(chkItem['pickListValues'])
		script = pickListValues['script']
		args['measurements'] = {'1': value}
		system.perspective.print("func is %s. Args are %s"%(script, args))
		value, msg = kanoaScripts.custom.quality.calculators.executeCalculator(script, args)
		if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': "%s returned error %s"%(script, msg)})		

		system.perspective.sendMessage("updateValue", {'chkItemId': chkItem['chkItemId'], 'measNumber': 1, 'value': value})	#We've modified the value, set the text box to the new value
		
	elif chkItem['dataTypeName'] == 'Boolean':
		system.perspective.print("value is Boolean")
		try: 
			if int(value) not in (0,1):
				endFunction("Check Value must be 1 or 0.")
				return
		except:
			endFunction("Check Value must be 1 or 0.")
			return	
	elif chkItem['dataTypeName'] in ('Integer', 'Float'):
		system.perspective.print("value is Number")
		try:
			value = float(value)
		except:	
			endFunction("Check Value must be numeric.")
			return	

		if chkItem['dataTypeName'] == 'Integer' and int(value) != value:	#Going to check here if someone has entered a real with decimal place and let them know prior to entering it
			endFunction("This checks requires a whole number. You entered a decimal.")
			return

	chkItemStateId, msg = self.getChkItemStateId(dict(chkItem), value, self.view.custom.chkItemStates)
	
	if msg is None:
		if chkItem['chkItemId'] == self.view.custom.chkSht.info.takenDateChkItemId and value is not None: 
			self.view.custom.chkSht.info.takenDate = system.date.parse(value, 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm')
		elif self.view.custom.chkSht.info.takenDate is None: self.view.custom.chkSht.info.takenDate = system.date.now()

		#Normally a measurement column will be selected but if the user wants all the measurements to receive the same value, then the selection data will contain the row displayName
		measurements = [measNum] if measNum else [i for i in range(1, chkItem['measCount'] + 1)]

		for measNum in measurements:
			chkItemEventInfo = {'chkShtEventId':self.view.custom.chkSht.info.chkShtEventId,	'chkItemEventId': None,	 'chkItemId': chkItem['chkItemId'], 'measNumber': measNum, 'chkItemValue': value, 'chkItemStateId': chkItemStateId}
			system.perspective.print("saveChkItemEvent() called with %s"%(chkItemEventInfo))
			if not system.kanoa.quality.event.saveChkItemEvent(chkItemEventInfo, self.view.custom.security.userId): system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': "Failed to save the last check value %s)"%chkItemEventInfo})
			else: 
				system.perspective.sendMessage('showInfoToast', {'message': "%s value has been updated"%chkItem['chkItemName']})
				self.view.custom.chkSht.chkItems[str(chkItem['chkItemId'])].measurements[measNum-1]['chkItemValue'] = value	#If we are doing calcuations we should make sure the vlaue has been updated

		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.chkSht.chkItems")
		import time	#Need the chkItem values to all have updated before doing any calculations
		time.sleep(0.1)
		self.updateCheckCalculations(chkItemId, measNum, None)

	endFunction(msg)
#	selectNextCheck(chkItem['chkItemId'], measNum)

	return
